issue.body:
### Describe the bug
Set

```
settings.storage = {
  type = "postgres";
  config = {
     host = "postgresql.some.domain";
     ...
  };
};
```

Error:

```
Oct 20 08:34:07 servers2 (install)[30685]: dex.service: Failed to set up mount namespacing: /run/systemd/unit-root/run/postgresql: No such file or directory
```

But I never said I wanted to connect to postgresql on the local box. This is a remote postgresql server I am connecting to.

Looking at the nix code there is the clear assumption that if `cfg.settings.storage.type == "postgres"` then postgres is a local instance. Which is clearly incorrect.

### Steps To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. As above.

### Expected behavior
There should not be any error.

### Screenshots
As above.

### Additional context
This is not the only error, also seeing:

```
Oct 20 08:34:07 servers2 (install)[30685]: dex.service: Failed at step NAMESPACE spawning /nix/store/j4fwy5gi1rdlrlbk2c0vnbs7fmlm60a7-coreutils-9.1/bin/install: No such file or directory
```

Which is something I don't really understand. Suspect it might be something to do with configuring the systemd service to use a chroot maybe?


### Notify maintainers

@SuperSandro2000
